author: profbananaslug
body:
i've got a scrim in like 2 hours so i hit the books on this whole teamspeak ban thing and i got a dear friend to send me the teamspeak rules:

"-Your name must be your IGN (Or similar according to a staff member)
-Follow chat rules
-Follow ALL staff instruction.
-No screamers.
-It is your responsibility to understand the rules in the channel you are located in.
-No voice modifiers. 
-All pokes most follow the "cursing allowed" channel rules (if both players are in Nightclub, then nightclub rules apply)
-Use your common sense.
Refer to the "Support" section of our forums if you have any staff complaints or issues."

my ban reason was "impersonating users" however, as is quite clear, there is no rules against doing so. the only rule i broke was the first one, "your name must be your IGN", and i saw one time a dude got kicked and then banned for only an hour for doing so and it's been like 20 hours now so....

also here's the teamspeak thing, i think: KElOTy3xEka/7Gl9eV/mCXfIBvY=
